children: CEO Nir Brenmiller to Discuss Planned Joint Applications with Major Industrial Companies, Opportunities Under Evaluation in Five European Countries and the Long-Term Revenue Potential of the Projects
Webinar to Be Held on Wednesday, December 2, 2026, at 10:00 AM Eastern Time; Investors Are Invited to Submit Questions in Advance
New York, New York--(Newsfile Corp. - November 25, 2026) -
BrenX Ltd.
("BrenX" or the "Company"),

a provider of thermal energy storage and integrated industrial energy solutions, today announced that its Chief Executive Officer Nir Brenmiller will host an investor webinar on Wednesday, December 2, 2026, at 10:00 AM Eastern Time. Mr. Brenmiller will discuss the Company's plans to pursue opportunities under the European Commission's 2026 Heat Auction under the EU Innovation Fund (the "Heat Auction"), which has a planned budget of €1 billion, and will review other recent developments across the Company's business. The European Commission has said it plans to launch the Heat Auction on December 3, 2026, the day after the webinar.

The webinar follows the Company's November 20, 2026 announcement that it plans to submit joint applications with multinational industrial companies to the Heat Auction. BrenX is evaluating opportunities in Germany, France, Belgium, Spain and Hungary with approximately 10 industrial companies, including multinational corporations that are active in the food, chemicals and tire industries, and intends to identify approximately five potential projects for which it may prepare joint applications. Based on current estimates, a typical project could generate average annual revenue of approximately €2-3 million over a potential operating period of 10-15 years. This estimate is indicative and does not represent contracted revenue or a signed agreement.

During the webinar, Mr. Brenmiller is expected to explain how the Heat Auction works, including the 25% bid bonus the auction rules provide for projects that deploy qualifying energy storage, and how the Company's bGen™ thermal energy storage technology may be deployed for the projects under evaluation. He is also expected to review progress at the Company's project at Tempo Beverages, a producer of Pepsi and Heineken beverages in Israel, construction of its bGen™ system at Wolfson Medical Center, its planned integrated energy resource center in Hungary, which is intended to combine solar generation, battery storage and thermal storage, and its recent settlement agreement with the European Investment Bank. He will also discuss the Company's strategy to develop, own, operate and optimize energy assets that bring power, heat, renewable generation and storage together around the needs of industrial customers, with the goal of generating recurring revenue.

"We believe Europe's €1 billion Heat Auction represents one of the most significant commercial opportunities in the Company's history, and we want our shareholders to hear directly from us about how we are pursuing it," said Nir Brenmiller, Chief Executive Officer of BrenX. "During the webinar, I will explain how the auction works, describe the opportunities we are evaluating with major industrial companies across five European countries, and update investors on our projects, our balance sheet and our strategy to serve industrial customers with integrated power and heat solutions. We also want to answer the questions that matter most to our investors, so I encourage shareholders to send us their questions in advance."

Mr. Brenmiller will answer questions submitted in advance. Investors are encouraged to send their questions to BRNX@crescendo-ir.com by Tuesday, December 1, 2026. The Company intends to address as many questions as possible during the webinar, subject to time constraints.

About BrenX Ltd.

BrenX provides thermal energy storage and integrated industrial energy solutions. Building on its proprietary bGen™ thermal energy storage technology, the Company is expanding its strategy to develop, own, operate and optimize energy assets that may combine local generation, electrical and thermal storage, grid connectivity, and intelligent energy management around customer needs. BrenX is headquartered in Rosh HaAyin, Israel. For more information, visit
